contract: #3717: Windsurf (500042) reads in Spell.dbc as effect 0 SPELL_EFFECT_FORCE_CAST (140) on EffectImplicitTargetA 5 TARGET_UNIT_PET with EffectTriggerSpell 537152, and effect 1 SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA (6) on the caster with EffectApplyAuraName 313 and EffectSpellClassMask (2048, 16, 0); SpellFamilyName 22, CastingTimeIndex 1 (instant), RangeIndex 5 (40 yd), RecoveryTime 90000, DurationIndex 8 (15000 ms). Its enUS description promises 'Command your Air Elemental to windsurf to you, intercepting the next melee or ranged attack made against you, and allowing you to cast Shock and Call Lightning while moving for $d.' Both clauses are delivered by native paths and no script or SQL exists or is needed. Spell::EffectForceCast (SpellEffects.cpp:1311) makes the pet cast 537152 with its master as the unit target; 537152 applies aura 111 SPELL_AURA_ADD_CASTER_HIT_TRIGGER on TARGET_UNIT_MASTER with amount 100 (EffectBasePoints 99 + EffectDieSides 1) and ProcCharges 1, which Unit::GetMeleeHitRedirectTarget (Unit.cpp:8563) consumes on the next melee or ranged attack. Aura 313's handler slot is HandleNULL, but the effect is registered in m_modAuras before handler dispatch, and Unit::CanCastSpellWhileMoving ends with HasAuraTypeWithAffectMask(SPELL_AURA_313, info), lifting SPELL_FAILED_MOVING for the spells the mask selects: Shock 503326 carries SpellFamilyFlags[0] 2048 against mask word 0 2048. The scenario shows in the same run that a moving Shock deals nothing without Windsurf and completes with it, and that the redirect charge survives the Stormbringer's own casts but is spent by one incoming melee attack. The issue body misquotes the record (effect 140 with trigger 1 in slot 2) and omits the aura-313 effect; the shipped row is as stated above.
